scripts.test:agent: node --test tests/*.test.js && echo "✅ Tests passed." || (echo "❌ Tests failing. You MUST inspect and fix failing spec before continuing." 1>&2; exit 2)
scripts.check:agent: biome check --error-on-warnings src/ tests/ && { echo "✅ Biome checks passed."; } || { echo "❌ Biome checks failing. Fix the diagnostics above. Then re-run the command." 1>&2; exit 2; }
